command: ghdl --synth --std=08 top.vhd -e top
version: GHDL 6.0.0 (tarball) [Dunoon edition]
exit: 0
--- stderr
--- stdout
library ieee;
use ieee.std_logic_1164.all;
entity top is
  port (
    clk: in std_ulogic;
    d: in std_ulogic;
    q: out std_ulogic;
    y: out std_ulogic
  );
end entity;

library ieee;
use ieee.std_logic_1164.all;
use ieee.numeric_std.all;

architecture rtl of top is
  signal wrap_clk: std_logic;
  signal wrap_d: std_logic;
  signal wrap_q: std_logic;
  signal wrap_y: std_logic;
  signal n6 : std_logic;
  signal n7 : std_logic;
begin
  wrap_clk <= clk;
  wrap_d <= d;
  q <= wrap_q;
  y <= wrap_y;
  wrap_q <= n7;
  wrap_y <= n6;
  -- top.vhd:22:18
  n6 <= not wrap_d;
  -- top.vhd:17:5
  process (wrap_clk)
  begin
    if rising_edge (wrap_clk) then
      n7 <= wrap_d;
    end if;
  end process;
end rtl;
